arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and, from their own web search, can't be repaired. They offer to buy their own replacement, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. Do you consent to the tenant installing their own machine? And how do you want the existing machine handled (inspect/repair by us, disconnect and remove, or store), at your cost, not the tenant's?
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; we arrange removal/disposal or storage of the existing LG at your cost (recommended once diagnosis confirms it is beyond repair)
Have our contractor inspect the LG first, then decide
Decline the tenant's machine and arrange repair/replacement yourself
arguments.update: No contractor assigned and no visit booked. The tenant's diagnosis is unverified. The tenant cannot be charged for removing the landlord's machine. Routine job; we will chase if no answer in 3 days.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace the landlord's LG washing machine with their own. Needs landlord consent (alteration, not a repair). Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory.
